overview: Dar, is the son of a king, who's hunted by a priest after his birth and grows up in another family. When he becomes a grown man, his new father is murdered by savages and he discovers that he's the ability to communicate with the animals, which leads him on his quest for revenge against his father's killers.
tagline: Born with the courage of an eagle, the strength of a black tiger, and the power of a god.
title: The Beastmaster
